falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes at a new 52-week high and is up at least 4% from today's close, with the VIX closing below 14 on that same day.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini-top analog and UNKNOWN/HOLD call are wrong: price resolved as a confirmed upside breakout, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes at least 5% below today's close and US high-yield OAS widens by at least 50 basis points versus today's level.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: HOLD is wrong: the June-2019-style mini top resolved into a clear risk-off drawdown that required a sell, not a hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: For 5 consecutive sessions within 14 days, more than 70% of S&P 500 constituents close above their 50-day moving average and the NYSE advance-decline line closes at a new 52-week high.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The unknown topping regime is invalidated: breadth confirms a broad advance, so the phase is risk-on continuation rather than an unresolved mini top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
